data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Rangeley Capital's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in BHR and STHO.

BHR had a preliminary contested proxy filing (PREC14A) filed October 14, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1574085/000109690626001545/0001096906-26-001545-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
